about: Lucia breaks the lineup: every GTA story lead since GTA III (2001) counted, 13, all men (our count from each game's article). GTA 6's Lucia Caminos, co-lead with Jason Duval, is the first woman to lead a GTA story since then. Turn: the first GTA (1997, PC) already let you pick a woman. Rockstar's own words for Lucia from rockstargames.com/VI. Factory Delta #6.

lines.say: G T A 6 breaks a thirteen-man lineup.

lines.text: Count every GTA story lead since GTA 3, in 2001.
lines.say: Count every G T A story lead since G T A 3, in two thousand one.

lines.text: Thirteen leads. Every single one, a man.
So who finally breaks the lineup?
Lucia Caminos. She shares GTA 6 with Jason Duval.
